name: Table Converter
description: Convert tables between Markdown, Excel, CSV, HTML, JSON, SQL and more
help: Paste a table on the left. Markdown tables, HTML tables, JSON arrays, cells copied from Excel or Google Sheets (TSV) and CSV (comma, semicolon or pipe separated) are recognised automatically; you can also pick the format.
Choose the output on the right: Markdown, CSV, TSV, HTML, JSON, a bordered plain-text table, SQL INSERT statements or LaTeX.
Markdown output pads columns so they line up, counting Chinese, Japanese and Korean characters as two columns. Turn on Compact for minimal tables.
Click a column header in the preview to switch its alignment (none, left, center, right). Use Header to treat the first row as the header, and Transpose to swap rows and columns.
SQL output writes numbers as numbers and everything else as quoted text; values with leading zeros such as 007 stay text, and empty cells become NULL.
